patches.name: Ayoomi Instant Rewards
patches.description: Instantly grant ad rewards for games using Ayoomi SDK (Serpent Chain Defense) without watching ads or triggering mediation timeouts.

patches.name: Ayoomi SDK Init Short Circuit
patches.description: [Deprecated] Superseded by Unity Lifecycle Protection (Section 2: instantAyoomiInitState). Kept safe as a no-op to prevent duplicate hook VerifyError.

patches.name: Loading Completion Short Circuit
patches.description: Experimental: send UIUpgreateLoading.<Start>b__17_0 once, 30 seconds after Unity resumes. Requires a matching Unity GameObject and parameterless receiver; device validation required.

patches.name: Native Loading Mask Bypass
patches.description: SCD v123 ARM64: deactivate UIUpgreateLoading on its first Update, with SCD.NativeMask entry/return logs. Reveals the underlying screen; does not complete pending asset operations. Requires the exact supported libil2cpp.so.

patches.name: PairIP Protection Bypass
patches.description: Bypass PairIP license checking and anti-tamper self-termination so the app can start on re-signed / non-root builds (Galaxy S24, etc.).

options.title: Neuter LicenseClient root triggers
options.description: Neuter LicenseClient.checkLicense, initializeLicenseCheck, scheduleAppShutdown, and error handlers.

options.title: Bypass Application.attachBaseContext check
options.description: Neuter PairIP Application.attachBaseContext license verification trigger.

options.title: Neuter LicenseActivity exit triggers
options.description: Neuter LicenseActivity.exitApp(), closeApp(), and onStart() to prevent the paywall/error shutdown activity from killing the process.

patches.name: Play Asset Delivery Fallback
patches.description: Redirect Unity Play Asset Delivery (PAD) asset queries to base.apk. Fixes infinite loading screen caused by YooAsset/Unity hanging on PACK_UNAVAILABLE (-2) on re-signed / non-root builds (Galaxy S24, etc.).

patches.name: SCD Runtime Diagnostics
patches.description: Diagnostic builds only: enable Android debuggable so ADB run-as can sample the stalled UnityMain thread. Disable this patch for normal builds.

patches.name: Unity Lifecycle Protection
patches.description: Prevent Unity from calling finish()/kill() or pausing shutdown on re-signed / non-root builds (Galaxy S24, etc.). Fixes startup crashes and initialization infinite wait loops.

options.title: Neuter UnityPlayer.kill() and finish()
options.description: Prevent Unity native runtime errors from closing the host Activity.

options.title: Instant Ayoomi Init Callback & SDK State Force-Success
options.description: Force isInitSDKSuccess/isInitSDK/isAymSDKInit to true and immediately invoke onAyoomiInited in AyoomiApplication to prevent untrusted environment detection and PlayerData wipe. Default true.

options.title: Suppress FCM Permission Dialog
options.description: Mock FCM notification permission as true to prevent Android 13+ permission popups from backgrounding the Unity activity during startup.

options.title: Neuter CheckEntry Infinite Retry
options.description: Neuter AyoomiApplication.CheckEntry() infinite retry loop (0x98967f / 9,999,999 retries) that blocks startup when offline or when servers disconnect.

options.title: Spoof Play Store Package Signature (db83fba5)
options.description: Spoof PackageManager.getPackageInfo() signature to authentic Google Play certificate (MD5 75:3B:19:17:2B:CE:B7:C7:18:04:B0:C6:A9:F2:FD:0A / hash db83fba5). Bypasses local signature check, skips Application.Quit(-1001), and prevents player data wipe to null in timer coroutine. Default true.

patches.name: Unity Native Quit Guard
patches.description: SCD v123 ARM64: ignore Application.Quit(-1001), the shutdown observed on the re-signed build. Other exit codes retain the original native quit behavior. Experimental; exact original libil2cpp.so required.
